units_and_semantics.total_metal: RAMSES code metal mass density; C..Fe ejecta only in the current deposition contract
units_and_semantics.delayed_cooling: RAMSES delayed-cooling reservoir; SNII channel only

source_of_index_formula: read_hydro_params.f90: inener=ndim+3; imetal=nener+ndim+3; idelay=imetal+1; ichem=idelay+1 when delayed_cooling=.true. and aton=.false.
production_requirements: The executable and this map must be built from the same source identity.
Any ATON or alternative NVAR layout requires a new versioned map and a separate binary.
Runtime startup must validate every active index and reject overlap or NVAR mismatch.
